content: contains 110,540 articles with abstractive summaries. Following BIBREF27, we split these into 100,834/9,706 training/test examples, based on the date of publication (the test set contains all articles published from January 1, 2007 onward). We used 4,000 examples from the training as validation set. We also followed their filtering procedure, documents with summaries less than 50 words were removed from the dataset. The filtered test set (NYT50) includes 3,452 examples. Sentences were split with the Stanford CoreNLP toolkit BIBREF26 and pre-processed following BIBREF27. Input documents were truncated to 800 tokens.
